cases.title: Generate password with default or valid criteria and copy to clipboard
cases.description: Verify that a user can specify length, select character type checkboxes, click 'Generate Password', view the password in the result display, and copy it successfully with a 3-second notification.

cases.title: Password generation with no criteria selected
cases.description: Verify that when no character type checkboxes are selected and 'Generate Password' is clicked, the result area remains empty.

cases.title: Copy functionality behavior when result area is empty
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'copy-to-clipboard-button' when no password is displayed leaves the clipboard unchanged and shows no notification.

cases.title: Password length boundary values and constraints
cases.description: Verify password length enforcement for boundary values (minimum 4 and maximum 20) using the 'password-length-input' field.

cases.title: Uppercase letters inclusion and exclusion handling
cases.description: Verify that toggling the 'include-uppercase-checkbox' correctly includes or excludes uppercase letters based on its final state after multiple toggles.

cases.title: Lowercase letters inclusion and exclusion handling
cases.description: Verify that toggling the 'include-lowercase-checkbox' correctly includes or excludes lowercase letters based on its final state after multiple toggles.

cases.title: Numbers inclusion and exclusion handling
cases.description: Verify that toggling the 'include-numbers-checkbox' correctly includes or excludes numbers based on its final state after multiple toggles.

cases.title: Symbols inclusion and exclusion handling
cases.description: Verify that toggling the 'include-symbols-checkbox' correctly includes symbols from the predefined set when checked and excludes them when unchecked.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level test cases are clear, distinct, cover all requirements thoroughly, and are fully testable without any blockers.
All cases and requirements are well-defined, testable, and accurately aligned without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: e2edev_bench_40-R-1: Testable behavior includes setting password length via 'password-length-input' (4-20), selecting character type checkboxes, generating passwords via 'generate-password-button', displaying results in 'result-display', and copying via 'copy-to-clipboard-button'. Boundaries: length values 4 and 20. Normal path: valid length and criteria selections yield matching password. Abnormal paths: no criteria selected leaves result area empty. Ambiguities: exact set of allowed symbols is unspecified. e2edev_bench_40-R-2: Testable behavior involves copying displayed passwords and showing a 3-second notification 'Password copied to clipboard!'. Boundaries: 3-second duration. Normal path: password present copies successfully and displays notification. Abnormal paths: no password present leaves clipboard unchanged and shows no notification. e2edev_bench_40-R-3: Testable behavior focuses strictly on numeric input constraints for length. Boundaries: minimum length 4, maximum length 20. Normal path: valid inputs generate passwords of exact length. Abnormal/edge paths: values below 4 or above 20 (handling invalid out-of-range bounds). e2edev_bench_40-R-4: Testable behavior includes toggling uppercase letters via 'include-uppercase-checkbox'. Normal path: checked includes at least one uppercase letter, unchecked excludes all. Edge/abnormal paths: multiple toggles before generation; state persistence. e2edev_bench_40-R-5: Testable behavior covers lowercase letters via 'include-lowercase-checkbox'. Normal path: checked includes at least one lowercase letter, unchecked excludes all. Edge paths: multiple toggles prior to generation. e2edev_bench_40-R-6: Testable behavior includes numbers via 'include-numbers-checkbox'. Normal path: checked includes at least one number, unchecked excludes all numbers entirely. Edge paths: multiple toggles. e2edev_bench_40-R-7: Testable behavior includes symbols via 'include-symbols-checkbox' using predefined symbols ('!@#$%^&*(){}[]=<>/,.'). Normal path: checked includes symbols, unchecked excludes symbols. Abnormal path: all checkboxes unchecked results in an empty string in 'result-display'.
